title: Kubernetes in Practice: Deploy, Scale and Debug a Service
concept: Take the containerised API from the Docker course to a Kubernetes cluster: Deployments and Services, config and secrets, probes, rolling updates, autoscaling, resource limits, Gateway API routing and the kubectl habits that find a broken pod fast. Challenges are manifests graded by a scheduler and rollout simulator.
description: Take the containerised API from the Docker course to a Kubernetes cluster: Deployments and Services, config and secrets, probes, rolling updates, autoscaling, resource limits and the kubectl habits that find a broken pod fast. Challenges are manifests graded by a scheduler and rollout simulator. 9 lessons, each applying the tool to a real production situation, with 1-2 graded challenges per lesson.

learningOutcomes.text: Run an API as a Deployment behind a Service, configured from ConfigMaps and Secrets.
Write probes that tell the truth and roll out new versions without dropping traffic, with a way back.
Size pods with requests and limits, read OOMKilled and throttling, and autoscale on real load.
Route outside traffic to services by host and path with TLS through the Gateway API.
Debug failing pods from status, events and logs, and run migrations and scheduled work as Jobs and CronJobs.

knownIssues: Challenges grade manifests with a simulator of documented Kubernetes behaviour (validation, selectors, rollouts, probes, autoscaling, routing, Jobs), not on a real cluster.
testedVersions are not yet re-checked on a live cluster.
